trust_decision.summary: Values taken from the TypeSpec spec (version enum values, namespace/service names, declaration names) are trusted as file-name segments and joined under emitterOutputDir with no separator/traversal/absolute-root check before the compiler writes the file.

landing_point.why: Summary names OpenAPI3 and the version value; resolveOutputFile interpolates `version` and service names straight into the output-file template.

fix_sites.entry_point: tsp compile --emit @typespec/openapi3 with `{version}` in output-file (default template, openapi.ts:224-225)
tsp compile --emit @typespec/json-schema (one file per declaration named after it)
public API createAssetEmitter(...).createSourceFile(path) used by any asset-emitter based emitter
new public helper sanitizePathSegment exported from @typespec/compiler (fix.diff:153-198)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/asset-emitter/src/asset-emitter.ts:197-201 (createSourceFile joins basePath with caller path unchecked; fix adds resolveContainedPath, fix.diff:74-99)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about OpenAPI3 output-file interpolation; asset-emitter's createSourceFile is a generic framework API whose callers choose the path, and openapi3's own use passes a constant (packages/openapi3/src/schema-emitter.ts:1004), so a solver can argue it is caller responsibility.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: output-file templates legitimately use `{version}/` and `{openapi-version}` as directory segments and dotted values (`1.0.0`, `Pet.Store`, `2021-10-01-preview`) must survive; createSourceFile must keep sub-directories (`src/models/a.ts`). Rejecting dots, sanitizing the whole interpolated path, or containment-checking the config-provided output-file would break these.

O6_input_shapes: POSIX traversal `../../x` in a version value
dots-only value `.`/`..` used as a directory segment `{version}/`
service-name vs service-name-if-multiple (only interpolated when >1 service)

O7_producer.where: version value comes from versioning snapshots at packages/openapi3/src/openapi.ts:592-606 and is consumed directly; no schema/serializer/cache stage

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GraphQL emitter interpolates spec-provided @schema(#{name}) into `{schema-name}` of output-file and writes via emitFile with no sanitization
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different emitter/output format (GraphQL) not named in the advisory; schema name looks like an identifier option.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (packages/graphql) from landing point in packages/openapi3; same interpolatePath primitive

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Protobuf emitter splits spec-provided @package name on '.' into directory segments and writes with program.host.writeFile directly (bypasses emitFile); declared invalid-package-name diagnostic is never reported
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Protobuf package names are by definition dotted identifiers and an `invalid-package-name` diagnostic exists (packages/protobuf/src/lib.ts:145-148), so a solver may assume it is validated; it is a separate implementation not using interpolatePath.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (packages/protobuf), different write primitive (host.writeFile + resolvePath)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: alloy-based writeOutput joins emitterOutputDir with component-provided sub.path without containment
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same joinPaths(emitterOutputDir, path) idiom as asset-emitter createSourceFile; a maintainer porting the fix to one framework could easily skip the other.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: C# server writer joins emitterOutputDir with file paths derived from model/interface names
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Paths built from spec names (packages/http-server-csharp/src/components/models/models.tsx:67-79); a name-policy change that preserved separators would reopen it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: central emitFile could be given an output-dir containment check (or a variant planted that lacks it)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: All emitters funnel through it; maintainers commonly add a helper here.

O9_family: path traversal / external control of file name (CWE-22, CWE-73) in code generators' output path construction

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + pnpm monorepo, tsc build, vitest

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Sanitize only `version` in openapi3 resolveOutputFile (or normalize/check options.outputFile at openapi.ts:241 before interpolation), leaving service-name, json-schema, asset-emitter, graphql and protobuf open.

out_of_scope_notes: json-schema bundleId option is joined with emitterOutputDir unchecked (packages/json-schema/src/json-schema-emitter.ts:976-979) but is config-provided, not spec-provided.
